verdict.rationale: Smooth's core interface is natural language: tasks are plain-English instructions passed to `run()`, data extraction works by describing what you want, and via the CLI users simply ask their agent to do something on the web. A community user reports that a complex prompt worked well. missing for 10: more than a single brief independent hands-on report, and documentation of how ambiguous or failed natural-language instructions are handled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: task = smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight from London to Paris today")
Ask Claude to do something on the web. It will use Smooth automatically.
No parsing HTML, no writing selectors - just describe what you want.
I just wrote a complex prompt and it did a good job.
